decisions.reason: The library indexes C^m by 0,...,m-1, as explicitly defined in rem-complex-euclidean-space-dictionary and def-wirtinger-operators-in-several-complex-variables. Hence k<m covers every coordinate. The smooth degree-zero kernel is holomorphic; local Dolbeault exactness, smooth-module acyclicity and global positive-degree vanishing establish the claimed sheaf acyclicity.

The old title omits the necessary cohomology-surjectivity hypothesis; a zero cochain map to an infinite-dimensional complex concentrated in degree q disproves the unqualified reading. The Statement already has both hypotheses. Checked the surjective cocycle-plus-boundary map, compact perturbation and quotient-openness argument. Repaired only the title and manifest title mirror.

The cited coherent-module definition uses def-complex-manifolds-and-holomorphic-vector-bundles, whose Definition starts with m>=1. Thus zero-dimensional manifolds are outside the supplied convention. Checked finite-jet closedness via Krull intersection, complete quotient topology, local matrix lifts, closed compatible families, and open mapping for independence. No repair is needed.

The expression 1/j lacked an explicit positive index range. Added integers j>=1 in proof step 2.1 and its contract derivation. These compact sets exhaust every compact target subset; Cauchy bounds, Ascoli and diagonal convergence give compact free restriction, and the open presentation quotient transfers compactness to coherent sections. The Statement remains unchanged.
